it.title: Startup Legal Toolkit — Strumenti legali gratuiti per founder | ilTuoAvvocato.com
it.description: Tre strumenti gratuiti per chi fonda una startup: ripartisci le quote tra cofondatori, simula il vesting e scopri quali documenti legali ti servono.
it.heading: Gli strumenti legali per chi fonda una startup

en.title: Startup Legal Toolkit — Free legal tools for founders | ilTuoAvvocato.com
en.description: Free tools for startup founders: split equity between co-founders, simulate vesting and find out which legal documents you need.
en.heading: Legal tools for startup founders

it.title: Calcolatore ripartizione quote tra cofondatori | Startup Legal Toolkit
it.description: Calcola una ripartizione indicativa delle quote tra 2–5 cofondatori in base a idea, tempo, capitale, competenze e ruolo. Formula trasparente, gratis.
it.heading: Calcolatore ripartizione quote

en.title: Co-founder equity split calculator | Startup Legal Toolkit
en.description: Work out an indicative equity split between 2–5 co-founders based on idea, time, capital, skills and role. Transparent formula, free.
en.heading: Equity split calculator

it.title: Simulatore vesting per founder: cliff e good/bad leaver | Startup Legal Toolkit
it.description: Simula il vesting delle quote di un founder: durata, cliff e frequenza di maturazione. Scopri cosa succede se un socio esce al mese X.
it.heading: Simulatore vesting

en.title: Founder vesting simulator: cliff and good/bad leaver | Startup Legal Toolkit
en.description: Simulate how a founder's shares vest: duration, cliff and vesting frequency. See what happens if a co-founder leaves in month X.
en.heading: Vesting simulator

it.title: Quali documenti legali servono alla tua startup? Quiz gratuito | Startup Legal Toolkit
it.description: Rispondi a 7 domande e ricevi una checklist personalizzata: patti tra fondatori, vesting, SAFE, work for equity e proprietà intellettuale.
it.heading: Quali documenti mi servono?

en.title: Which legal documents does your startup need? Free quiz | Startup Legal Toolkit
en.description: Answer 7 questions and get a personalised checklist: founders' agreement, vesting, SAFE, work for equity and intellectual property.
en.heading: Which documents do I need?

it.title: Privacy | Startup Legal Toolkit
it.description: Nessun cookie, nessun tracciamento, nessun dato inviato: tutti i calcoli del Startup Legal Toolkit avvengono nel tuo browser.
it.heading: Privacy

en.title: Privacy | Startup Legal Toolkit
en.description: No cookies, no tracking, no data sent anywhere: all Startup Legal Toolkit calculations run in your browser. Only your language preference is stored.
en.heading: Privacy
